normativeScope: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
Trusted Tester-style ownership, applicability, and adequacy checks
EN 301 549 web Annex C as WCAG pass-through context
currentVerdict: Remediated for the generated fixture/prompt path and the live broad-scope sidecar path. The lane remains sidecar-only and cannot clear conformance.

findings.finding: Earlier media control rows produced no packets and could be misread as scoped OK results.
findings.remediation: Media controls now emit explicit SCOPED_MEDIA_CONTROL/UNCERTAIN packets with adequate-alternative-or-exception-observed, not clears or no-review passes.

findings.finding: Several control outcomes relied on synthetic metadata rather than extracted transcript/description content.
findings.remediation: Generated fixtures include inline transcript/description content, and the media inventory extracts [data-v3-transcript], details, and [data-v3-description-text] content for adequacy scoring.

findings.finding: Live media findings discarded load-bearing evidence claims and extracted media metadata/details, so live positives could not support LIKELY_BARRIER even when the fixture path could.
findings.remediation: runBroadScopeForUrl now emits owned-media-element, media-content-model-observed when a content model exists, alternative-missing-or-inadequate-observed for missing/inadequate alternatives, and media evidenceDetails. buildReviewPacketsFromBroadScope preserves evidenceDetails/facts into observed.

findings.finding: Live video media findings were hard-coded to SC 1.2.2 regardless of 1.2.1 video-only, 1.2.3, or 1.2.5 scope.
findings.remediation: mediaWarningSc now preserves fixture-scoped 1.2.1/1.2.2/1.2.3/1.2.5 and falls back to warning-specific scoped SCs.

findings.finding: Scoped media SC results could be misread as all-1.2.x conformance.
findings.remediation: Prompts instruct the judge to assess only packet.sc/rawSc and not infer pass/fail for adjacent 1.2.x SCs.

findings.finding: The prompt did not encode the SC-specific alternative matrix strongly enough.
findings.remediation: Prompts include explicit rules for 1.2.1, 1.2.2, 1.2.3, and 1.2.5, including captions vs transcripts/media alternatives vs audio description.

findings.finding: Visual references could be misread as proving caption/transcript/description adequacy.
findings.remediation: Media visual checks use visualAgreement:null and describe screenshots as target/context corroboration only.

findings.finding: LIKELY_OK was allowed in sidecar prompts despite no registered media claim family.
findings.remediation: media-alternative-inventory allows only LIKELY_BARRIER and UNCERTAIN; controls and exceptions remain sidecar evidence only.

findings.finding: Caption adequacy could fall back to nearby transcript text, falsely suppressing scoped 1.2.2 caption failures.
findings.remediation: captionAdequacy now uses caption text only. Transcript text may support media alternatives, but not the captions SC.

newMediaRegressions: media inventory does not let transcript text satisfy scoped 1.2.2 captions
live broad-scope media packets preserve SC, structural evidence, and media details

remainingLimitations: This lane is still a sidecar, not an authoritative 1.2.x publication path.
The generated content model is fixture-provided; real media requires caption/transcript/description file retrieval, ASR or media-content modelling, and adequacy review.
Screenshots corroborate target/context only unless a future packet explicitly says the media content model was derived from those pixels.
Each packet scopes one SC. Adjacent 1.2.x obligations remain not assessed unless separately enumerated.
